title: DEMO — Waterlogging Reported in Multiple Mohali Sectors After Heavy Rainfall
rawContent:
MOHALI: Heavy rainfall since early morning has led to waterlogging in several sectors of Mohali, causing inconvenience to commuters and residents.

According to residents, Sectors 70, 71, and the Phase 7 market area have been worst hit, with water accumulating on roads to nearly knee-deep levels in some low-lying stretches.

The Airport Road connecting Mohali to the Chandigarh International Airport reportedly has significant water accumulation, and several commuters reported their vehicles getting stuck.

"The road near our society in Sector 70 is completely waterlogged. We can't even get out of the gate," said one resident who did not wish to be named.

Municipal Corporation officials said that pumping operations have been initiated in the worst-affected areas. However, continued rainfall is hampering drainage efforts.

Traffic police have not yet issued a formal advisory, but commuters are being urged to use alternative routes where possible.

The IMD has predicted continued heavy rainfall over the region for the next 12-18 hours.
